sundai:fc:406.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:406.question: Scientists were able to _____ a new material in the lab.
sundai:fc:406.fullSentence: Scientists were able to synthesize a new material in the lab.

sundai:fc:407.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:407.question: A high fever is a common _____ of the flu.
sundai:fc:407.fullSentence: A high fever is a common symptom of the flu.

sundai:fc:408.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:408.question: Don't waste your time on such a _____ matter.
sundai:fc:408.fullSentence: Don't waste your time on such a trivial matter.

sundai:fc:409.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:409.question: In the movie, the tribe was portrayed as _____ and violent.
sundai:fc:409.fullSentence: In the movie, the tribe was portrayed as barbarian and violent.

sundai:fc:410.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:410.question: The company hired a new _____ to fill the open position.
sundai:fc:410.fullSentence: The company hired a new employee to fill the open position.
sundai:fc:410.explanation: employee: 従業員。examinee: 受験者。

sundai:fc:411.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:411.question: She handed out a _____ advertising the new store.
sundai:fc:411.fullSentence: She handed out a leaflet advertising the new store.

sundai:fc:412.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:412.question: He was awarded a full _____ to study at Harvard.
sundai:fc:412.fullSentence: He was awarded a full scholarship to study at Harvard.

sundai:fc:413.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:413.question: Strong _____ is essential for any successful team.
sundai:fc:413.fullSentence: Strong leadership is essential for any successful team.

sundai:fc:414.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:414.question: New filters are used to _____ the drinking water.
sundai:fc:414.fullSentence: New filters are used to purify the drinking water.
sundai:fc:414.explanation: purify: 浄化する。unify: 統一する。simplify: 簡易化する。

sundai:fc:415.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:415.question: The new leader tried to _____ the divided country.
sundai:fc:415.fullSentence: The new leader tried to unify the divided country.

sundai:fc:416.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:416.question: This app is designed to _____ your daily schedule.
sundai:fc:416.fullSentence: This app is designed to simplify your daily schedule.

sundai:fc:417.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:417.question: Fixing the printer every week has become quite _____.
sundai:fc:417.fullSentence: Fixing the printer every week has become quite troublesome.

sundai:fc:418.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:418.question: A _____ breakfast helps you stay energized all morning.
sundai:fc:418.fullSentence: A wholesome breakfast helps you stay energized all morning.

sundai:fc:419.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:419.question: He always speaks to his elders in a _____ manner.
sundai:fc:419.fullSentence: He always speaks to his elders in a respectful manner.

sundai:fc:420.cat: 社会・時事・学術語彙
sundai:fc:420.question: It seems _____ to buy so much food that will go bad.
sundai:fc:420.fullSentence: It seems wasteful to buy so much food that will go bad.

sundai:fc:421.question: Playing too much tennis can cause _____ in the elbow.
sundai:fc:421.fullSentence: Playing too much tennis can cause arthritis in the elbow.
sundai:fc:421.explanation: arthritis: 関節炎。-itis: 炎症を表す接尾辞。

sundai:fc:422.question: 「気管支炎」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:422.fullSentence: He was diagnosed with bronchitis after coughing for weeks.
sundai:fc:422.explanation: bronchitis: 気管支炎。gastritis: 胃炎。

sundai:fc:423.question: Eating spicy food often gives him _____.
sundai:fc:423.fullSentence: Eating spicy food often gives him gastritis.

sundai:fc:424.question: The diamonds began to _____ under the bright lights.
sundai:fc:424.fullSentence: The diamonds began to glitter under the bright lights.

sundai:fc:425.question: The candle began to _____ as the wind blew through the window.
sundai:fc:425.fullSentence: The candle began to flicker as the wind blew through the window.

sundai:fc:426.question: He tends to _____ his boss to get a promotion.
sundai:fc:426.fullSentence: He tends to flatter his boss to get a promotion.

sundai:fc:427.question: The old man began to _____ something under his breath.
sundai:fc:427.fullSentence: The old man began to mutter something under his breath.

sundai:fc:428.question: The arrow pointed _____, toward the center of the building.
sundai:fc:428.fullSentence: The arrow pointed inward, toward the center of the building.

sundai:fc:429.question: After the long trip, they finally headed _____.
sundai:fc:429.fullSentence: After the long trip, they finally headed homeward.

toefl:se:1.answer: I agree more with Andrew and believe that ghostwriting is often deceptive and should be restricted.
toefl:se:1.fullSentence: I agree more with Andrew and believe that ghostwriting is often deceptive and should be restricted.
toefl:se:1.japanese: 私はアンドリューの意見により賛成で、ゴーストライティングはしばしば人を欺くものであり、制限されるべきだと思います。
toefl:se:1.explanation: 「agree more with 人」で「〜の意見により賛成」という比較の同意表現。
toefl:se:1.relatedInfo: I side with Andrew's view / I lean toward Andrew's opinion
